name: What does it cost to coordinate a kitchen sink and faucet?

mainEntity.name: What does it cost to coordinate a kitchen sink and faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the **sink material, faucet finish, and installation complexity**. A coordinated upgrade can be affordable if you are swapping like-for-like, but costs rise when you need new holes, new plumbing parts, or a more premium fixture set.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prices vary widely based on materials, faucet features, and whether installation requires plumbing or countertop changes.
